summary.text: The executive summary defines digital health as the systematic use of information and communication technology and data to support decisions and improve health. It notes rapid innovation and explains that the former system categories have been renamed and reorganized as types of services and applications.

sections.title: Page 8

summary.text: Lists the main changes in this edition, such as referring to people rather than clients, more inclusive language, added metadata and synonyms, and new interventions including pandemic-era capabilities. It ends by naming the renamed services and applications section and the main intervention groups.

sections.title: Page 9

summary.text: Describes the classification as a shared language for how digital technologies serve health system needs, aimed at governments, technologists, providers, donors, implementers and researchers. It lists uses such as national strategies, legislation, training, research and capacity building.

sections.extract: ما هو تصنيف التدخلات والخدمات والتطبيقات الرقمية في مجال الصحة؟ يُقَسّم تصنيف التدخلات والخدمات والتطبيقات الرقمية في مجال ا/ ة الطرق المختلفة التي تُستخدم بها التكنولوجيات الرقمية والمتنقلة لدعم احتياجات الأفراد والنظام الصحي. ويُقرٌ التصنيف بالطرق المتنوعة التي يتم بها الاستفادة من القدرات الرقمية في شتى التطبيقات والخدمات الرقمية» لمعالجة التحديات والاحتياجات الشخصية وتحديات واحتياجات النظام الصحي. ويستهدف الإطار

sections.title: Page 10

summary.text: Explains that the classification is organized around health system challenges in nine categories, digital interventions grouped by primary user, and types of services and applications. It gives an example linking targeted communication to under-use of services.

sections.title: Page 11

summary.text: Explains how digital interventions map to types of services and applications, such as logistics information systems and electronic medical records, as a basis for interoperability. It includes a figure linking challenges, interventions and applications; parts of the text are garbled.

summary.text: Presents use cases, the first showing how an immunization programme could analyse why new mothers miss vaccinations and choose a digital intervention to address it. Another use case describes searching a registry of digital health projects filtered by health focus.

summary.text: Defines key terms: digital health intervention, digital health application and health system challenge, with examples such as loss to follow-up. A short reference list follows, with partly garbled URLs.
